annotations.title: Token USD price from Uniswap v3 pools

description: USD price of any ERC-20 token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism, computed from the deepest Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH, read live from the chain. Returns the pool, its fee tier, the quote-token reserve and a thin-liquidity flag. Spot price, not a time average. No pool returns 404, uncharged. Use to value a token or check a quote before a swap or payment. Example: address=0xcbB7C0000aB88B473b1f5aFd9ef808440eed33Bf, chain=base. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
